description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 04.09.2023 to 10.09.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory matter concerning the administration and enforcement of customs laws, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
